Subject: Post-signature MAP: Rehearsal cadence, canary plan & rollback drill for TritonHealth deployment

Hi Samir —

Congrats again on the signature. As discussed in last week's call, attached is a proposed rehearsal cadence we want to embed into the Mutual Action Plan (MPA). The goal: validate canary routing, migration steps, training readiness, and a short rollback drill before we shift traffic. High level:

- Week 0 (prep): configuration freeze, test env snapshot, access checks.
- Week 1 (rehearsal): dry-run day (no traffic) + training sessions for ops and SRE.
- Week 2 (canary 1): 5% traffic for 48 hours, health check cadence every 30 minutes.
- Week 3 (canary 2): 25% traffic for 72 hours, QA evals and prompt/eval regression checks.
- Week 4 (ramp/handback): full cutover window with rollback drill window T+2.

Attached: MPA_Rehearsal_Roster_v1.xlsx (owner list + training RSVP) and Canary_Runbook_Triton.pdf (runbook skeleton). I put estimated owners in the roster but want to finalize with your ops leads.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm a preferred 2-week window between Aug 31 and Sep 18 for the rehearsal + canary sequence?
2) Who from Triton ops will own the rollback decision (name + mobile)?
3) Any required compliance evidence (audit logs, region-residency checks) we should surface in the rehearsal?

Irene and Jonas will run the technical rehearsals and own the runbook updates.

Thanks —
Grace
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: Rehearsal cadence, canary plan & rollback drill for TritonHealth deployment

Thanks Grace — really useful outline. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Window: Sep 7–18 looks okay but prefer any heavy-canary activity before our payroll cutoff (Sep 15). Can we front-load the heavier traffic earlier in that window?
- Rollback owner: I'll nominate Laura Chen (Director, Platform Ops) but want the escalation path to include our on-call SRE (alias ops@tritonhealth.com).
- Compliance: we need a short evidence packet for our security review — specifically: audit log samples, data-at-rest encryption confirmation, and a sandbox dataset scrub report. Can you include sample logs in the rehearsal?

Also, can we add a short prompt-eval to the canary (10 canonical prompts + acceptance thresholds) so our clinical QA can sign off?

I'll sync with Laura and ops and confirm who will attend the rehearsal.

—Samir

Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: Rehearsal cadence, canary plan & rollback drill for TritonHealth deployment

Hi Samir —

Great questions. Quick responses and proposed updates to the runbook:

1) Front-loaded ramp: we can invert the canary sequence so Canary 1 = 10% for 48h (quick evaluation) and Canary 2 = 30% for 48–72h, keeping the heaviest load before Sep 15. I'll mark the runbook with timeboxes.

2) Evidence packet: we'll generate a rehearsal audit sample (redacted) and include an encryption/keys confirmation page. We will NOT share HSM private keys, only the KMS key ids and timestamps.

3) Prompt-eval: Jonas will own the 10 canonical prompts. Proposed acceptance: >=95% non-regressive token similarity + no safety flags. If clinical QA wants stricter thresholds, add them to the MPA.

I've made inline edits to Canary_Runbook_Triton.pdf and uploaded v1.1 to the Drive link (see HubSpot and Drive links in the MPA). I'll also drop a short checklist into the roster for who must be present at the rollback drill (primary + secondary decision owners).

On logistics: proposed rehearsal dry-run date: Thu Sep 9 (walkthrough, training). Canary 1 start: Mon Sep 13. Canary 2 start: Wed Sep 15 (cutover window to be agreed).

If that aligns with your schedule we'll lock slots and push the updated MPA to HubSpot.

Thanks —
Irene
Director, Implementation
Redwood Inference
